title: Filament internal moves and the target-placement check
summary: Moves the 14 Filament internals to `Filament\Internal\<Area>` per the oracle, then adds `tests/Arch/TargetPlacementTest.php`: every non-retired oracle row (each part of a split) is declared at its `target_path` with its target FQCN, no production file declares a superseded FQCN, and the tree under each root equals knowledge/target-structure plus the #amendments rows.
why: Phase exit: 'after P3 the tree under each root equals knowledge/target-structure'. Without a placement check a forgotten row stays at its old FQCN while all scans pass (they resolve by FQCN). Hard risk: Filament resource pages stay at `Resources\<Resource>\Pages` by framework convention (target-structure rule 2) — not moved.

include: Filament rows with action `move` and phase `P3` (knowledge/type-map#zone-filament) by the #moves procedure; Filament views/config references and `FilamentDefinitionsCheck` unaffected

`tests/Arch/TargetPlacementTest.php`: reads `tests/Arch/Fixtures/target-map.json`; for rows whose action is not `retire`, splits `target`/`target_path` on ` + ` and asserts the file exists and declares that FQCN; asserts no production file under any root declares a `current` FQCN of a moved/renamed/split/retired row; reports all differences at once
Any row still not at its target after P3.1–P3.9 is fixed here (moved) or, if it cannot be, reported as a friction entry and an owner question — never skipped in the test

reads.why: Rules every P3 item follows (reference + amendments win, no shims, placement, oracle, allowlists, snapshots, migration lines, tests)
Exact validation commands, PHP 8.4, driver ports, composer update rule
Exact move procedure: oracle-driven Rector map, git mv, string sweep, __DIR__ depth, snapshot regeneration
Filament tree and the resource-page exception
Existing oracle reader conventions (split rows, retired rows)

rules: The placement test has a non-vacuity case (a synthetic oracle with one misplaced row fails).
guidance: Drive the moves from the oracle file tests/Arch/Fixtures/target-map.json with a scratch script (knowledge/p3-execution#moves step 1); do not read the 300 KB file into context.

validation.cmd: php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/pest tests/Feature/Parity tests/Feature/InactiveCost tests/Regression --fail-on-skipped
composer analyse && composer lint:check && composer refactor:check && composer api:check

deliverables: TargetPlacementTest green on the whole tree
